import nltk
from string import punctuation
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Constants
PUNCTUATION = set(punctuation)

def task_func(text):
    if not text:
        return None

    import re
    from collections import Counter

    # Extract contiguous non-whitespace tokens that begin with "$"
    tokens = re.findall(r"\$\S+", text)

    # Keep only tokens starting with "$" that contain at least one non-punctuation
    # character after the leading "$"
    valid_tokens = [
        token for token in tokens
        if token.startswith("$") and any(ch not in PUNCTUATION for ch in token[1:])
    ]

    if not valid_tokens:
        return None

    counts = Counter(valid_tokens)
    items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))

    words = [word for word, _ in items]
    freqs = [freq for _, freq in items]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(words, freqs)
    ax.set_xlabel("Words")
    ax.set_ylabel("Frequency")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=45)

    return ax
